parts.name: skirt
parts.keep: the lower half of the rotted homespun wool tunic from the twisted rope belt down to its torn, ragged hem, the rope belt and its hanging knife sheath at the top, as a garment on its own: no body, no legs, no arms, no hands, the garment hollow inside where the body was, seen straight from the front
